meta.title: Doubt-Dispersing Decree
meta.description: Though beset by doubt and plagued by suffering, one must still carry on with a righteous heart.

units.rawText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.
units.displayText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

spans.text: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

units.rawText: Alcyone and I struggle as we turn corner after corner in the labyrinth. Alcyone is on the brink of bluescreening due to excessive stress, and she carries the unconscious Electra on her back and carries out her tasks like a puppet, operating on her most basic reflexes.
units.displayText: Alcyone and I struggle as we turn corner after corner in the labyrinth. Alcyone is on the brink of bluescreening due to excessive stress, and she carries the unconscious Electra on her back and carries out her tasks like a puppet, operating on her most basic reflexes.

spans.text: Alcyone and I struggle as we turn corner after corner in the labyrinth. Alcyone is on the brink of bluescreening due to excessive stress, and she carries the unconscious Electra on her back and carries out her tasks like a puppet, operating on her most basic reflexes.

units.rawText: Alcyone...
units.displayText: Alcyone...

spans.text: Alcyone...

units.rawText: Alcyone!
units.displayText: Alcyone!

spans.text: Alcyone!

units.rawText: The girl finally responds after I raise my voice. She looks up at me, but her pupils are filled with a black digital backdrop, without so much as a symbol in them.
units.displayText: The girl finally responds after I raise my voice. She looks up at me, but her pupils are filled with a black digital backdrop, without so much as a symbol in them.

spans.text: The girl finally responds after I raise my voice. She looks up at me, but her pupils are filled with a black digital backdrop, without so much as a symbol in them.

options.rawText: Pull yourself together, don't forget you still have a mission to carry out!
options.displayText: Pull yourself together, don't forget you still have a mission to carry out!

spans.text: Pull yourself together, don't forget you still have a mission to carry out!

options.rawText: It'll be fine, this too shall pass.
options.displayText: It'll be fine, this too shall pass.

spans.text: It'll be fine, this too shall pass.
(Hug her.)

units.rawText: Hearing the word "mission" seems to jolt Alcyone out of her stupor. She nods silently, then turns back to check on Electra.
units.displayText: Hearing the word "mission" seems to jolt Alcyone out of her stupor. She nods silently, then turns back to check on Electra.

spans.text: Hearing the word "mission" seems to jolt Alcyone out of her stupor. She nods silently, then turns back to check on Electra.

units.rawText: Faint ripples of 1s and 0s appear in the black backdrop of her eyes, but they soon vanish into blank confusion once again.
units.displayText: Faint ripples of 1s and 0s appear in the black backdrop of her eyes, but they soon vanish into blank confusion once again.

spans.text: Faint ripples of 1s and 0s appear in the black backdrop of her eyes, but they soon vanish into blank confusion once again.

units.rawText: After seeing my face, Alcyone nods. The smile she forces on her face looks worse than her crying—but I probably look the same way, too. It's very hard for us to keep going without Atlas.
units.displayText: After seeing my face, Alcyone nods. The smile she forces on her face looks worse than her crying—but I probably look the same way, too. It's very hard for us to keep going without Atlas.

spans.text: After seeing my face, Alcyone nods. The smile she forces on her face looks worse than her crying—but I probably look the same way, too. It's very hard for us to keep going without Atlas.

units.rawText: The digital backdrop in Alcyone's eyes slowly fills with faint ripples of 1s and 0s, but they soon vanish into blank confusion once again.
units.displayText: The digital backdrop in Alcyone's eyes slowly fills with faint ripples of 1s and 0s, but they soon vanish into blank confusion once again.

spans.text: The digital backdrop in Alcyone's eyes slowly fills with faint ripples of 1s and 0s, but they soon vanish into blank confusion once again.

units.rawText: Alcyone gently pats my back. The smile she forces to her face looks worse than her crying—but I probably look the same way, too.
units.displayText: Alcyone gently pats my back. The smile she forces to her face looks worse than her crying—but I probably look the same way, too.

spans.text: Alcyone gently pats my back. The smile she forces to her face looks worse than her crying—but I probably look the same way, too.

units.rawText: The digital backdrop in her eyes slowly fills with faint ripples of 1s and 0s, but they soon vanish into blank confusion once again.
units.displayText: The digital backdrop in her eyes slowly fills with faint ripples of 1s and 0s, but they soon vanish into blank confusion once again.

spans.text: The digital backdrop in her eyes slowly fills with faint ripples of 1s and 0s, but they soon vanish into blank confusion once again.

units.rawText: Come, Alcyone. We need to get into the Middle Ring. This is for Atlas, too.
units.displayText: Come, Alcyone. We need to get into the Middle Ring. This is for Atlas, too.

spans.text: Come, Alcyone. We need to get into the Middle Ring. This is for Atlas, too.

units.rawText: At...
units.displayText: At...

spans.text: At...

units.rawText: Whoosh—
units.displayText: Whoosh—

spans.text: Whoosh—

units.rawText: Before I can react, a purple flash grazes my shoulder. I look back, gritting my teeth against the pain, and see an Entropic that looks far more dangerous than its fellows turning the corner.
units.displayText: Before I can react, a purple flash grazes my shoulder. I look back, gritting my teeth against the pain, and see an Entropic that looks far more dangerous than its fellows turning the corner.

spans.text: Before I can react, a purple flash grazes my shoulder. I look back, gritting my teeth against the pain, and see an Entropic that looks far more dangerous than its fellows turning the corner.

units.rawText: Graahhh—!
units.displayText: Graahhh—!

spans.text: Graahhh—!

units.rawText: Ugh!
units.displayText: Ugh!

spans.text: Ugh!

units.rawText: <cmdr>...?
Alcyone's eyes regain some of their calm, as though my grunt has flipped a switch in her.
units.displayText: Alcyone's eyes regain some of their calm, as though my grunt has flipped a switch in her.

spans.text: Alcyone's eyes regain some of their calm, as though my grunt has flipped a switch in her.

units.rawText: Alcyone? Alcyone, are you feeling better?
units.displayText: Alcyone? Alcyone, are you feeling better?

spans.text: Alcyone? Alcyone, are you feeling better?

units.rawText: I need... to protect... <cmdr>...
units.displayText: I need... to protect... {교수}...

spans.text: I need... to protect...

units.rawText: Alcyone draws her bow and looses an arrow, but her target easily evades it.
units.displayText: Alcyone draws her bow and looses an arrow, but her target easily evades it.

spans.text: Alcyone draws her bow and looses an arrow, but her target easily evades it.

units.rawText: This is bad, Alcyone's in no condition to fight...
units.displayText: This is bad, Alcyone's in no condition to fight...

spans.text: This is bad, Alcyone's in no condition to fight...

units.rawText: We can't keep going on like this. This is as far as I travel with my strength alone...
units.displayText: We can't keep going on like this. This is as far as I travel with my strength alone...

spans.text: We can't keep going on like this. This is as far as I travel with my strength alone...

units.rawText: After sheltering Alcyone and Electra behind me, I look toward the elite Entropic that is slowly approaching me and send my systems into overdrive, looking for some way to solve our current predicament.
units.displayText: After sheltering Alcyone and Electra behind me, I look toward the elite Entropic that is slowly approaching me and send my systems into overdrive, looking for some way to solve our current predicament.

spans.text: After sheltering Alcyone and Electra behind me, I look toward the elite Entropic that is slowly approaching me and send my systems into overdrive, looking for some way to solve our current predicament.

units.rawText: I'm a Greater Sanctifier. Even if I'm not a combat specialist, I ought to have some degree of self-defense ability. Calm down, <cmdr>, think, how should you deal with this...
units.displayText: I'm a Greater Sanctifier. Even if I'm not a combat specialist, I ought to have some degree of self-defense ability. Calm down, {교수}, think, how should you deal with this...

spans.text: I'm a Greater Sanctifier. Even if I'm not a combat specialist, I ought to have some degree of self-defense ability. Calm down,
, think, how should you deal with this...

units.rawText: Dammit, if only Atlas were here...
units.displayText: Dammit, if only Atlas were here...

spans.text: Dammit, if only Atlas were here...

units.rawText: That's right, I think Atlas said this...
units.displayText: That's right, I think Atlas said this...

spans.text: That's right, I think Atlas said this...

units.rawText: What a surprise.
units.displayText: What a surprise.

spans.text: What a surprise.

units.rawText: Really? You did the same thing, though.
units.displayText: Really? You did the same thing, though.

spans.text: Really? You did the same thing, though.

units.rawText: Me?
units.displayText: Me?

spans.text: Me?

units.rawText: You were really good with short swords, and even better with weapon schematics. If you don't believe me, you can check your database and see.
units.displayText: You were really good with short swords, and even better with weapon schematics. If you don't believe me, you can check your database and see.

spans.text: You were really good with short swords, and even better with weapon schematics. If you don't believe me, you can check your database and see.

units.rawText: ...Does that mean I was the one who mentored Electra...
units.displayText: ...Does that mean I was the one who mentored Electra...

spans.text: ...Does that mean I was the one who mentored Electra...

units.rawText: Hahaha, yup. We decided by rolling on it.
units.displayText: Hahaha, yup. We decided by rolling on it.

spans.text: Hahaha, yup. We decided by rolling on it.

units.rawText: Short sword combat techniques... database... got it.
units.displayText: Short sword combat techniques... database... got it.

spans.text: Short sword combat techniques... database... got it.

units.rawText: Activating combat programs. Initiating learning module. Now loading action commands...
units.displayText: Activating combat programs. Initiating learning module. Now loading action commands...

spans.text: Activating combat programs. Initiating learning module. Now loading action commands...

units.rawText: I quickly load the relevant programs, then take Electra's weapons from her waist. I take a deep breath, then step into the oncoming Entropic's face.
units.displayText: I quickly load the relevant programs, then take Electra's weapons from her waist. I take a deep breath, then step into the oncoming Entropic's face.

spans.text: I quickly load the relevant programs, then take Electra's weapons from her waist. I take a deep breath, then step into the oncoming Entropic's face.

units.rawText: Groooar—
units.displayText: Groooar—

spans.text: Groooar—

units.rawText: <size=40>BRING IT ON!</size>
units.displayText: BRING IT ON!

spans.text: BRING IT ON!

units.rawText: I follow the program's prompts and engage the Entropic in melee, with close calls galore.
units.displayText: I follow the program's prompts and engage the Entropic in melee, with close calls galore.

spans.text: I follow the program's prompts and engage the Entropic in melee, with close calls galore.

units.rawText: There is a metallic clash, and then the Entropic roars as my blades plunge deep into its body.
units.displayText: There is a metallic clash, and then the Entropic roars as my blades plunge deep into its body.

spans.text: There is a metallic clash, and then the Entropic roars as my blades plunge deep into its body.

units.rawText: The monster's eyes flare with rage, and liquid operands splash from the grazes on my body.
units.displayText: The monster's eyes flare with rage, and liquid operands splash from the grazes on my body.

spans.text: The monster's eyes flare with rage, and liquid operands splash from the grazes on my body.

units.rawText: (Pants)
units.displayText: Pants

spans.text: Pants

units.rawText: My visual systems replay data I've never seen before, then load more data from my neural cloud systems that have long since been overloaded by stress.
units.displayText: My visual systems replay data I've never seen before, then load more data from my neural cloud systems that have long since been overloaded by stress.

spans.text: My visual systems replay data I've never seen before, then load more data from my neural cloud systems that have long since been overloaded by stress.

units.rawText: Alcyone, Electra...
units.displayText: Alcyone, Electra...

spans.text: Alcyone, Electra...

units.rawText: A faint tingling washes over me. How long have I fought? How much longer must I still fight?
units.displayText: A faint tingling washes over me. How long have I fought? How much longer must I still fight?

spans.text: A faint tingling washes over me. How long have I fought? How much longer must I still fight?

units.rawText: I can't... at least, not now...
units.displayText: I can't... at least, not now...

spans.text: I can't... at least, not now...

units.rawText: Clang—
units.displayText: Clang—

spans.text: Clang—

units.rawText: Before I can finish my self-directed pep talk, the enemy has seized on the opening my dazed state has given it, and an unavoidable, fatal blow closes in on me.
units.displayText: Before I can finish my self-directed pep talk, the enemy has seized on the opening my dazed state has given it, and an unavoidable, fatal blow closes in on me.

spans.text: Before I can finish my self-directed pep talk, the enemy has seized on the opening my dazed state has given it, and an unavoidable, fatal blow closes in on me.

units.rawText: I reflexively throw myself backward, and my neural cloud goes white.
units.displayText: I reflexively throw myself backward, and my neural cloud goes white.

spans.text: I reflexively throw myself backward, and my neural cloud goes white.

units.rawText: Is this the end...
units.displayText: Is this the end...

spans.text: Is this the end...

units.rawText: Sorry, Atlas, I did my best...
units.displayText: Sorry, Atlas, I did my best...

spans.text: Sorry, Atlas, I did my best...

units.rawText: Yes, which is why you can leave the rest to me.
units.displayText: Yes, which is why you can leave the rest to me.

spans.text: Yes, which is why you can leave the rest to me.

units.rawText: A familiar voice fills my ears, and my back suddenly lands in an expanse of pillowy softness.
units.displayText: A familiar voice fills my ears, and my back suddenly lands in an expanse of pillowy softness.

spans.text: A familiar voice fills my ears, and my back suddenly lands in an expanse of pillowy softness.

units.rawText: Two hands reach out from behind me. One wraps around my waist, while the other extends past my hands and catches the incoming blade.
units.displayText: Two hands reach out from behind me. One wraps around my waist, while the other extends past my hands and catches the incoming blade.

spans.text: Two hands reach out from behind me. One wraps around my waist, while the other extends past my hands and catches the incoming blade.

units.rawText: Someone has caught me from behind. The last thing my nearly-overloaded senses see is a pair of gentle eyes filled with self-reproach.
units.displayText: Someone has caught me from behind. The last thing my nearly-overloaded senses see is a pair of gentle eyes filled with self-reproach.

spans.text: Someone has caught me from behind. The last thing my nearly-overloaded senses see is a pair of gentle eyes filled with self-reproach.

units.rawText: I was late, <cmdr>, I'm sorry...
units.displayText: I was late, {교수}, I'm sorry...

spans.text: I was late,
, I'm sorry...

units.rawText: E...os? Atlas...
units.displayText: E...os? Atlas...

spans.text: E...os? Atlas...

units.rawText: Shh—
units.displayText: Shh—

spans.text: Shh—

units.rawText: Sleep, rest. It'll all be okay soon.
units.displayText: Sleep, rest. It'll all be okay soon.

spans.text: Sleep, rest. It'll all be okay soon.

units.rawText: Her coaxing whisper transmutes all other sounds into a pleasing melody. Even the Entropic's growls fade away.
units.displayText: Her coaxing whisper transmutes all other sounds into a pleasing melody. Even the Entropic's growls fade away.

spans.text: Her coaxing whisper transmutes all other sounds into a pleasing melody. Even the Entropic's growls fade away.

units.rawText: This is the last bit of information that I consciously process.
units.displayText: This is the last bit of information that I consciously process.

spans.text: This is the last bit of information that I consciously process.

units.rawText: Tartarus Sector, at the entrance to the Middle Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.
units.displayText: Tartarus Sector, at the entrance to the Middle Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

spans.text: Tartarus Sector, at the entrance to the Middle Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

units.rawText: System hibernation complete. Now performing self-test...
units.displayText: System hibernation complete. Now performing self-test...

spans.text: System hibernation complete. Now performing self-test...

units.rawText: Self-test complete. Systems normal. Now initiating...
units.displayText: Self-test complete. Systems normal. Now initiating...

spans.text: Self-test complete. Systems normal. Now initiating...

units.rawText: Alcyone!
units.displayText: Alcyone!

spans.text: Alcyone!

units.rawText: As I suddenly return to wakefulness, I catapult myself into an upright position.
units.displayText: As I suddenly return to wakefulness, I catapult myself into an upright position.

spans.text: As I suddenly return to wakefulness, I catapult myself into an upright position.

units.rawText: You're awake, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: You're awake, {교수}.

spans.text: You're awake,

units.rawText: Relax. This is the entrance to the Middle Ring. Eos brought all of you over. We're safe for now.
units.displayText: Relax. This is the entrance to the Middle Ring. Eos brought all of you over. We're safe for now.

spans.text: Relax. This is the entrance to the Middle Ring. Eos brought all of you over. We're safe for now.

units.rawText: I'm sorry we were late.
units.displayText: I'm sorry we were late.

spans.text: I'm sorry we were late.

units.rawText: Did you complete your mission?
units.displayText: Did you complete your mission?

spans.text: Did you complete your mission?

units.rawText: ...Yes. Eos and I achieved our objective in the Outer Ring.
units.displayText: ...Yes. Eos and I achieved our objective in the Outer Ring.

spans.text: ...Yes. Eos and I achieved our objective in the Outer Ring.

units.rawText: Eosphorus shows me a plain-looking longsword.
units.displayText: Eosphorus shows me a plain-looking longsword.

spans.text: Eosphorus shows me a plain-looking longsword.

units.rawText: We found a relic that the first generation of Sanctifiers left behind in the Tartarus Sector. It possesses the natural ability to slay Entropics and it will be one of the pillars of our upcoming mission.
units.displayText: We found a relic that the first generation of Sanctifiers left behind in the Tartarus Sector. It possesses the natural ability to slay Entropics and it will be one of the pillars of our upcoming mission.

spans.text: We found a relic that the first generation of Sanctifiers left behind in the Tartarus Sector. It possesses the natural ability to slay Entropics and it will be one of the pillars of our upcoming mission.

units.rawText: A relic... you say? I see...
units.displayText: A relic... you say? I see...

spans.text: A relic... you say? I see...

units.rawText: Then what is our upcoming mission?
units.displayText: Then what is our upcoming mission?

spans.text: Then what is our upcoming mission?

units.rawText: ...And here I thought you'd ask about something else before going to that question.
units.displayText: ...And here I thought you'd ask about something else before going to that question.

spans.text: ...And here I thought you'd ask about something else before going to that question.
Looks like you all know.

options.rawText: We can better mourn him through actions rather than words.
options.displayText: We can better mourn him through actions rather than words.

spans.text: We can better mourn him through actions rather than words.

units.rawText: That wasn't anybody's fault. This suffering that we did not plan for must be given back to the enemy, and not vented on our comrades.
units.displayText: That wasn't anybody's fault. This suffering that we did not plan for must be given back to the enemy, and not vented on our comrades.

spans.text: That wasn't anybody's fault. This suffering that we did not plan for must be given back to the enemy, and not vented on our comrades.

units.rawText: And besides, you completed your strategic objective. That's enough.
units.displayText: And besides, you completed your strategic objective. That's enough.

spans.text: And besides, you completed your strategic objective. That's enough.

units.rawText: ...The fact remains that I did not prepare enough for this and did not anticipate the Entropics to do this. I have no excuse.
units.displayText: ...The fact remains that I did not prepare enough for this and did not anticipate the Entropics to do this. I have no excuse.

spans.text: ...The fact remains that I did not prepare enough for this and did not anticipate the Entropics to do this. I have no excuse.

units.rawText: I brought Atlas' Sanctifier badge back. It's with Alcyone now. Do you want to see it?
units.displayText: I brought Atlas' Sanctifier badge back. It's with Alcyone now. Do you want to see it?

spans.text: I brought Atlas' Sanctifier badge back. It's with Alcyone now. Do you want to see it?

units.rawText: Eosphorus glances over, his eyes downcast.
units.displayText: Eosphorus glances over, his eyes downcast.

spans.text: Eosphorus glances over, his eyes downcast.

units.rawText: I follow his line of sight to Eos, who is tending to both Alcyone and Electra.
units.displayText: I follow his line of sight to Eos, who is tending to both Alcyone and Electra.

spans.text: I follow his line of sight to Eos, who is tending to both Alcyone and Electra.

units.rawText: I've sealed the wounds to Electra's body and applied emergency patches to the corresponding systems.
units.displayText: I've sealed the wounds to Electra's body and applied emergency patches to the corresponding systems.

spans.text: I've sealed the wounds to Electra's body and applied emergency patches to the corresponding systems.

units.rawText: Don't worry too much, Alcyone. She's alright. You've only just recovered from a neural cloud breakdown; are you alright?
units.displayText: Don't worry too much, Alcyone. She's alright. You've only just recovered from a neural cloud breakdown; are you alright?

spans.text: Don't worry too much, Alcyone. She's alright. You've only just recovered from a neural cloud breakdown; are you alright?

units.rawText: I'm fine, I can still fight.
units.displayText: I'm fine, I can still fight.

spans.text: I'm fine, I can still fight.

units.rawText: Alcyone... You don't have to push yourself too hard. You still have us.
units.displayText: Alcyone... You don't have to push yourself too hard. You still have us.

spans.text: Alcyone... You don't have to push yourself too hard. You still have us.

units.rawText: Eos embraces Alcyone and gently pats her back.
units.displayText: Eos embraces Alcyone and gently pats her back.

spans.text: Eos embraces Alcyone and gently pats her back.

units.rawText: If you're in pain or if you're lost, you can try praying to the gods, just like we used to do in the Chamber of Holy Discourse.
units.displayText: If you're in pain or if you're lost, you can try praying to the gods, just like we used to do in the Chamber of Holy Discourse.

spans.text: If you're in pain or if you're lost, you can try praying to the gods, just like we used to do in the Chamber of Holy Discourse.

units.rawText: Atlas has simply returned to the embrace of the gods. He...
units.displayText: Atlas has simply returned to the embrace of the gods. He...

spans.text: Atlas has simply returned to the embrace of the gods. He...

units.rawText: He's not there...
units.displayText: He's not there...

spans.text: He's not there...

units.rawText: Alcyone's vacuous eyes finally regain some of their color. She strokes Atlas' badge which Eosphorus gave her. Her voice is very soft, as though she's whispering to him.
units.displayText: Alcyone's vacuous eyes finally regain some of their color. She strokes Atlas' badge which Eosphorus gave her. Her voice is very soft, as though she's whispering to him.

spans.text: Alcyone's vacuous eyes finally regain some of their color. She strokes Atlas' badge which Eosphorus gave her. Her voice is very soft, as though she's whispering to him.

units.rawText: The Scriptures can't save a Sanctifier who perishes in Tartarus. He's not there.
units.displayText: The Scriptures can't save a Sanctifier who perishes in Tartarus. He's not there.

spans.text: The Scriptures can't save a Sanctifier who perishes in Tartarus. He's not there.

units.rawText: Perhaps the almighty gods truly are omnipotent, but They never helped Atlas or shone Their light on this unclean land.
units.displayText: Perhaps the almighty gods truly are omnipotent, but They never helped Atlas or shone Their light on this unclean land.

spans.text: Perhaps the almighty gods truly are omnipotent, but They never helped Atlas or shone Their light on this unclean land.

units.rawText: Ally...
units.displayText: Ally...

spans.text: Ally...

units.rawText: It's okay, Eos. We're on a mission. A very important mission.
units.displayText: It's okay, Eos. We're on a mission. A very important mission.

spans.text: It's okay, Eos. We're on a mission. A very important mission.

units.rawText: Alcyone gingerly takes the badge into her embrace, lightly stroking it through her clothes. When she looks up again, there seems to be a fire burning in her eyes.
units.displayText: Alcyone gingerly takes the badge into her embrace, lightly stroking it through her clothes. When she looks up again, there seems to be a fire burning in her eyes.

spans.text: Alcyone gingerly takes the badge into her embrace, lightly stroking it through her clothes. When she looks up again, there seems to be a fire burning in her eyes.

units.rawText: Sorry to make you worry.
units.displayText: Sorry to make you worry.

spans.text: Sorry to make you worry.

units.rawText: I'll make sure I take revenge for Electra and Atlas.
units.displayText: I'll make sure I take revenge for Electra and Atlas.

spans.text: I'll make sure I take revenge for Electra and Atlas.

units.rawText: ...Alright. We'll be with you.
units.displayText: ...Alright. We'll be with you.

spans.text: ...Alright. We'll be with you.

units.rawText: I've rested enough. How much longer until we can head out, Lord Eosphorus?
units.displayText: I've rested enough. How much longer until we can head out, Lord Eosphorus?

spans.text: I've rested enough. How much longer until we can head out, Lord Eosphorus?

units.rawText: We can move when the next labyrinth shift window arrives.
units.displayText: We can move when the next labyrinth shift window arrives.

spans.text: We can move when the next labyrinth shift window arrives.

units.rawText: Upon seeing Alcyone approach him, Eosphorus doesn't say much more, only nodding slightly to her and granting his tacit permission to take part in the upcoming operation.
units.displayText: Upon seeing Alcyone approach him, Eosphorus doesn't say much more, only nodding slightly to her and granting his tacit permission to take part in the upcoming operation.

spans.text: Upon seeing Alcyone approach him, Eosphorus doesn't say much more, only nodding slightly to her and granting his tacit permission to take part in the upcoming operation.

units.rawText: Alright, I understand. I'll go check in on Electra.
units.displayText: Alright, I understand. I'll go check in on Electra.

spans.text: Alright, I understand. I'll go check in on Electra.

units.rawText: Eosphorus, Alcyone...
units.displayText: Eosphorus, Alcyone...

spans.text: Eosphorus, Alcyone...

units.rawText: She's a strong, independent Greater Sanctifier, Eos.
units.displayText: She's a strong, independent Greater Sanctifier, Eos.

spans.text: She's a strong, independent Greater Sanctifier, Eos.

units.rawText: ...Yes.
units.displayText: ...Yes.

spans.text: ...Yes.

units.rawText: Eos pauses before she can speak, then nods and heads toward Alcyone and Electra again. Meanwhile, Eosphorus watches them from afar.
